title: Upstream Domain-Operated RequestType Derivation
rootCause: The upstream RequestTypeDerivationRuntimeExecutionResult carried semantic outcomes as data only, requiring downstream lowering to enumerate every semantic result kind.
changes: Added concrete continueForManifestProjection operation to each upstream runtime derivation outcome.
Added explicit projectable and not-projectable disposition ADT for the RequestType manifest projection boundary.
Changed lowering to consume the upstream domain operation and eliminate only the two projection dispositions.
Preserved all original semantic outcome kinds and assessment/integrity evidence.
Exported new upstream contract types from the core package entrypoint.
designNote: The remaining exhaustive elimination is over the two explicit projectability dispositions at the downstream lowering boundary; the upstream semantic outcome itself owns continueForManifestProjection. This avoids both a generic handler result and an upstream dependency on downstream manifest types.
